_doc: Candidates for the X seed list (fr-social, 2026-10-22), before verification. Each is checked once against SocialData by tools/verify_x_accounts.py: kept only if the account exists, is public and posted in the last 90 days. owner_entity follows the main registry's spelling so independent-source counts treat an account and its organisation's site as one entity; people are their own entity and carry the reason they were chosen. A second batch (batch 2) was added after the first verification kept 146 of 220, most of the drops being accounts silent for 90 days (several agencies, journals and preprint servers stopped posting on X in 2025).
